name: Low-Carb Turkey and Cabbage Skillet
why: Ground-turkey stovetop skillet dead-center in band on the source's own numbers: 469 cal / 8.7g carbs / 35.8g protein per serving. Structurally low-carb - turkey + bacon + cabbage + melted cheddar, no rice/pasta/potato/bean base - so the 35g carb ceiling is cleared with huge margin while calories land in the 450-600 sweet spot. High protein for the calories fits the catalog identity. Weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly from 14 oz turkey to ~3 lb for 14 servings. Distinct from the existing turkey-cabbage-roll-soup (a tomato-rice soup); this is a dry cheesy cabbage saute. PRICER-LANE value: carries four genuinely-absent board ingredients (scallions, smoked paprika, cilantro, vegetable broth) to prove the new-commodity queue.
confidence: high on nutrition and ingredients - read the published macros and full ingredient list from the source page. MEDIUM on source_servings: Carb Manager did not surface an explicit yield on the fetched page; 4 is the best estimate from the ingredient quantities (14 oz turkey), so treat servings as needing a re-check at spec time.
